instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security

questions.question: Why does the chapter insist tools and practices are both required?
questions.question_ar: ليش الفصل يشدّد إن الأدوات والممارسات الاثنين مطلوبين؟
options: Because practices only matter for regulated firms.
Because tools cannot be audited by third parties.
Tools alone are cost; practice alone is intent.
Because tools are cheap and practices are expensive.
options_ar: لأن الممارسات تهم المؤسسات المنظّمة فقط.
لأن الأدوات ما يمكن تدقيقها من طرف ثالث.
الأداة وحدها كلفة، والممارسة وحدها نيّة.
options_en: Because practices only matter for regulated firms.
Because tools cannot be audited by third parties.
Tools alone are cost; practice alone is intent.
Because tools are cheap and practices are expensive.
questions.explanation: A tool deployed without disciplined practice is just expense, and a practice without tooling never gets executed.
questions.explanation_ar: أداة منصّبة بلا ممارسة منظّمة تصير كلفة فقط، وممارسة بلا أدوات ما تتنفّذ أبداً.

questions.question: What must understanding of tools and practices move beyond, and toward what?
questions.question_ar: ما لازم يتجاوزه فهم الأدوات والممارسات، ونحو شنو؟
options: Beyond training, toward staffing ratios.
Beyond enumeration, toward integration and evaluation.
Beyond procurement, toward licence consolidation.
Beyond auditing, toward certification renewal.
options_ar: ما بعد التدريب، نحو نسب الكوادر.
ما بعد التعداد، نحو التكامل والتقييم.
ما بعد الشراء، نحو توحيد التراخيص.
ما بعد التدقيق، نحو تجديد الشهادات.
options_en: Beyond training, toward staffing ratios.
Beyond enumeration, toward integration and evaluation.
Beyond procurement, toward licence consolidation.
Beyond auditing, toward certification renewal.
questions.explanation: Strategic integration, continuous evolution and quantitative evaluation replace a list of product names.
questions.explanation_ar: التكامل الاستراتيجي والتطوّر المستمر والتقييم الكمّي تحلّ محل قائمة أسماء منتجات.

questions.question: At which layer does a web application firewall operate?
questions.question_ar: بأي طبقة يعمل جدار حماية تطبيقات الويب؟
options: The application layer, filtering HTTP and HTTPS.
The network layer, filtering IP packets.
The transport layer, filtering TCP segments.
The link layer, filtering Ethernet frames.
options_ar: طبقة التطبيق، ويرشّح HTTP و HTTPS.
options_en: The application layer, filtering HTTP and HTTPS.
The network layer, filtering IP packets.
The transport layer, filtering TCP segments.
The link layer, filtering Ethernet frames.
questions.explanation: It reads the application conversation itself, which is why it can recognise injection and scripting payloads.
questions.explanation_ar: يقرأ محادثة التطبيق نفسها، ولهذا يقدر يعرف حمولات الحقن والسكربتات.

questions.question: Which detection methods do modern WAFs deploy?
questions.question_ar: أي طرق كشف تستخدمها الجدارات الحديثة؟
options: Honeypots, tarpits and DNS sinkholes.
Checksums, parity bits and error correction.
Kerberos tickets and directory lookups.
Signatures, heuristic anomaly and AI filtering.
options_ar: مجاميع تحقّق وبتات تكافؤ وتصحيح أخطاء.
توقيعات وكشف شذوذ إرشادي وترشيح بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
options_en: Honeypots, tarpits and DNS sinkholes.
Checksums, parity bits and error correction.
Kerberos tickets and directory lookups.
Signatures, heuristic anomaly and AI filtering.
questions.explanation: The three named families are signature matching, heuristic anomaly detection, and AI-driven adaptive filtering.
questions.explanation_ar: العائلات الثلاث المذكورة هي مطابقة التوقيعات، وكشف الشذوذ الإرشادي، والترشيح التكيّفي المدفوع بالذكاء الاصطناعي.

questions.question: How is WAF efficiency expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعبَّر كفاءة الـWAF؟
options: False positive rate minus lambda times the true positive rate.
The product of the true and false positive rates.
True positive rate minus lambda times the false positive rate.
True positive rate plus lambda times the false positive rate.
options_ar: معدّل الإيجابيات الكاذبة ناقص لامدا × الصحيحة.
حاصل ضرب معدّلي الإيجابيات الصحيحة والكاذبة.
معدّل الإيجابيات الصحيحة ناقص لامدا × معدّل الإيجابيات الكاذبة.
معدّل الإيجابيات الصحيحة زائد لامدا × الإيجابيات الكاذبة.
options_en: False positive rate minus lambda times the true positive rate.
The product of the true and false positive rates.
True positive rate minus lambda times the false positive rate.
True positive rate plus lambda times the false positive rate.
questions.explanation: Detection ability is credited and false alarms are charged, so the score trades accuracy against usability.
questions.explanation_ar: القدرة على الكشف تُحسب لها، والإنذارات الكاذبة تُخصم، فالدرجة تقايض الدقة بالاستعمالية.

questions.question: What does the lambda weight represent?
questions.question_ar: شنو يمثّل وزن لامدا؟
options: The share of traffic that is malicious.
The organisation's tolerance for false positives.
The number of rules loaded into the WAF.
The encryption strength of inspected traffic.
options_en: The share of traffic that is malicious.
The organisation's tolerance for false positives.
The number of rules loaded into the WAF.
The encryption strength of inspected traffic.
questions.explanation: It encodes how much the business is hurt by blocking legitimate requests, so it is a policy choice rather than a technical constant.
questions.explanation_ar: يعبّر عن شكثر يتضرّر العمل من حجب طلبات شرعية، فهو خيار سياسة مو ثابت تقني.

questions.question: What happens when an organisation raises the lambda weight?
questions.question_ar: شنو يصير لمّا ترفع المؤسسة وزن لامدا؟
options: The score penalises false alarms more, so the WAF gets stricter.
The score rewards detection more, so the WAF blocks less.
The score becomes independent of the traffic mix.
The score ignores missed attacks entirely.
options_ar: الدرجة تعاقب الإنذارات الكاذبة أكثر، فيصير الجدار أكثر حذراً.
الدرجة تكافئ الكشف أكثر، فيحجب أقل.
الدرجة تصير مستقلة عن مزيج الترافيك.
options_en: The score penalises false alarms more, so the WAF gets stricter.
The score rewards detection more, so the WAF blocks less.
The score becomes independent of the traffic mix.
The score ignores missed attacks entirely.
questions.explanation: A higher weight makes a false alarm costlier than a miss in score terms, which is the right setting for a business that cannot afford outages.
questions.explanation_ar: وزن أعلى يخلي الإنذار الكاذب أغلى من التفويت بالدرجة، وهذا الضبط الصحيح لعمل ما يتحمّل انقطاعاً.

questions.question: What do vulnerability scanners probe applications for?
questions.question_ar: عن شنو تفحص ماسحات الثغرات التطبيقات؟
options: Only SQL injection and cross-site scripting flaws.
Runtime memory corruption while the code executes.
User behaviour anomalies tracked across whole sessions.
Misconfigurations, outdated components and unsafe patterns.
options_ar: ثغرات حقن SQL و XSS فقط.
أخطاء التهيئة والمكوّنات القديمة والأنماط غير الآمنة.
options_en: Only SQL injection and cross-site scripting flaws.
Runtime memory corruption while the code executes.
User behaviour anomalies tracked across whole sessions.
Misconfigurations, outdated components and unsafe patterns.
questions.explanation: They are automated probes for misconfiguration, obsolete components and insecure coding patterns rather than for novel logic flaws.
questions.explanation_ar: هي فاحصات آلية لأخطاء التهيئة والمكوّنات القديمة وأنماط البرمجة غير الآمنة، مو للعيوب المنطقية الجديدة.

questions.question: Which database do vulnerability scanners integrate with?
questions.question_ar: مع أي قاعدة بيانات تتكامل ماسحات الثغرات؟
options: The routing information base.
The identity provider directory.
Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures.
The certificate revocation list.
options_en: The routing information base.
The identity provider directory.
Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures.
The certificate revocation list.
questions.explanation: CVE gives every known weakness a common identifier, which is what lets a scanner's finding be matched to public knowledge.
questions.explanation_ar: CVE يعطي كل ضعف معروف معرّفاً مشتركاً، وهذا اللي يخلي نتيجة الفاحص تُطابَق بالمعرفة العامة.

questions.question: Where does RASP operate and what does it analyse?
questions.question_ar: وين يشتغل الـRASP وشنو يحلّل؟
options: At the DNS layer, analysing query patterns.
Inside the runtime, analysing execution flow and memory.
At the network edge, analysing packet headers.
In the build pipeline, analysing source code.
options_ar: عند طبقة DNS، ويحلّل أنماط الاستعلام.
داخل بيئة التشغيل، ويحلّل مسار التنفيذ والذاكرة.
عند حافة الشبكة، ويحلّل ترويسات الحزم.
داخل خط البناء، ويحلّل الكود المصدري.
options_en: At the DNS layer, analysing query patterns.
Inside the runtime, analysing execution flow and memory.
At the network edge, analysing packet headers.
In the build pipeline, analysing source code.
questions.explanation: It watches the application's internal behaviour — execution flow, API calls and memory states — rather than the traffic arriving at it.
questions.explanation_ar: يراقب السلوك الداخلي للتطبيق — مسار التنفيذ واستدعاءات API وحالات الذاكرة — مو الترافيك الواصل له.

questions.question: What is the essential difference between a WAF and RASP?
questions.question_ar: شنو الفرق الجوهري بين الـWAF والـRASP؟
options: The WAF sees external traffic; RASP sees internal execution.
The WAF is open source; RASP is always commercial.
The WAF runs in the cloud; RASP runs on hardware.
The WAF blocks requests; RASP only reports them.
options_ar: الـWAF يشوف الترافيك الخارجي، والـRASP يشوف التنفيذ الداخلي.
الـWAF مفتوح المصدر، والـRASP تجاري دائماً.
options_en: The WAF sees external traffic; RASP sees internal execution.
The WAF is open source; RASP is always commercial.
The WAF runs in the cloud; RASP runs on hardware.
The WAF blocks requests; RASP only reports them.
questions.explanation: An attack that slips past the WAF can still be caught by RASP, which is exactly the layered-defence argument.
questions.explanation_ar: الهجوم اللي يعدّي الـWAF يظل يقدر الـRASP يمسكه، وهذا بالضبط حجّة الدفاع الطبقي.

questions.question: How is runtime coverage expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعبَّر تغطية وقت التشغيل؟
options: Total execution paths over monitored ones.
Monitored paths multiplied by total paths.
Total paths minus monitored paths.
Monitored execution paths over the total.
options_en: Total execution paths over monitored ones.
Monitored paths multiplied by total paths.
Total paths minus monitored paths.
Monitored execution paths over the total.
questions.explanation: It is the fraction of the running code the protector actually observes, so it measures reach rather than accuracy.
questions.explanation_ar: هي نسبة الكود الشغّال اللي يراقبه الحامي فعلاً، فتقيس المدى مو الدقة.

questions.question: What does runtime coverage approaching one indicate?
questions.question_ar: شنو تدلّ عليه تغطية وقت تشغيل تقترب من الواحد؟
options: Fewer execution paths being monitored.
The application runs faster under load.
More comprehensive runtime protection.
More false positives during execution.
options_en: Fewer execution paths being monitored.
The application runs faster under load.
More comprehensive runtime protection.
More false positives during execution.
questions.explanation: Coverage near one means almost every path the code can take is observed, leaving few blind spots for an attacker.
questions.explanation_ar: التغطية قرب الواحد تعني إن تقريباً كل مسار ممكن للكود مُراقَب، فتبقى نقاط عمياء قليلة.

questions.question: How is the adversarial creativity factor expressed?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عامل الإبداع الخصمي؟
options: Total vulnerabilities minus discovered ones.
Discovered vulnerabilities over assumed ones.
Assumed vulnerabilities over discovered ones.
Discovered vulnerabilities times assumed ones.
options_en: Total vulnerabilities minus discovered ones.
Discovered vulnerabilities over assumed ones.
Assumed vulnerabilities over discovered ones.
Discovered vulnerabilities times assumed ones.
questions.explanation: It compares what human-led testing actually found against what automated analysis expected to find.
questions.explanation_ar: يقارن ما وجده الاختبار البشري فعلاً بما توقّع التحليل الآلي إيجاده.

questions.question: What does a factor greater than one signify?
questions.question_ar: شنو يعني عامل أكبر من الواحد؟
options: Human or hybrid testing found more than automation assumed.
Automation found more than human testing expected.
The scanner produced too many false positives.
The pentest was conducted without any tooling.
options_ar: الاختبار البشري أو الهجين وجد أكثر مما افترضته الأتمتة.
الأتمتة وجدت أكثر مما توقّعه البشري.
اختبار الاختراق تمّ بلا أي أدوات.
options_en: Human or hybrid testing found more than automation assumed.
Automation found more than human testing expected.
The scanner produced too many false positives.
The pentest was conducted without any tooling.
questions.explanation: Above one, adversarial creativity adds insight that scanning alone does not produce, which is the strategic argument for keeping humans in the loop.
questions.explanation_ar: فوق الواحد، الإبداع الخصمي يضيف رؤية ما تنتجها الفاحصات وحدها، وهذي حجّة إبقاء الإنسان بالحلقة.

questions.question: Where does the power of a SIEM lie?
questions.question_ar: وين تكمن قوة الـSIEM؟
options: In blocking attacks before they reach the app.
In storing raw packets for legal discovery.
In patching vulnerable dependencies automatically.
In event correlation that turns alerts into incidents.
options_ar: في حجب الهجمات قبل وصولها للتطبيق.
في تخزين الحزم الخام للاكتشاف القانوني.
في ربط الأحداث اللي يحوّل التنبيهات إلى حوادث.
options_en: In blocking attacks before they reach the app.
In storing raw packets for legal discovery.
In patching vulnerable dependencies automatically.
In event correlation that turns alerts into incidents.
questions.explanation: Isolated alerts are noise; correlation across sources is what produces an incident an analyst can actually act on.
questions.explanation_ar: التنبيهات المعزولة ضجيج؛ والربط بين المصادر هو اللي ينتج حادثة يقدر المحلّل يتصرّف بيها.

questions.question: On which three factors does event correlation strength depend?
questions.question_ar: على أي ثلاثة عوامل تعتمد قوة ربط الأحداث؟
options: User role, department and clearance level.
Encryption strength, key length and rotation.
Temporal proximity, source similarity and threshold.
Packet size, port number and protocol family.
options_ar: حجم الحزمة ورقم المنفذ وعائلة البروتوكول.
options_en: User role, department and clearance level.
Encryption strength, key length and rotation.
Temporal proximity, source similarity and threshold.
Packet size, port number and protocol family.
questions.explanation: Events that happen close together, come from the same source and clear the probability threshold are correlated into one incident.
questions.explanation_ar: الأحداث اللي تصير قريبة زمنياً، ومن نفس المصدر، وتتجاوز عتبة الاحتمال، تُربط بحادثة واحدة.

questions.question: Which three emerging tool classes does the chapter name?
questions.question_ar: أي ثلاث فئات أدوات ناشئة يذكرها الفصل؟
options: Load balancers, CDNs and reverse caches.
API gateways, cloud scanners and AI detection.
Tarpits, honeynets and DNS blackholes.
Password vaults, HSMs and smart cards.
options_ar: موازنات حمل و CDN وكاشات عكسية.
بوّابات API وماسحات سحابية وكشف بالذكاء الاصطناعي.
خزائن كلمات مرور و HSM وبطاقات ذكية.
options_en: Load balancers, CDNs and reverse caches.
API gateways, cloud scanners and AI detection.
Tarpits, honeynets and DNS blackholes.
Password vaults, HSMs and smart cards.
questions.explanation: API gateways with schema validation and OAuth, container and serverless scanners, and AI anomaly detection predicting attack sequences.
questions.explanation_ar: بوّابات API بتحقّق schema و OAuth، وماسحات حاويات وserverless، وكشف شذوذ بالذكاء الاصطناعي يتنبّأ بتسلسلات الهجوم.

questions.question: What do scanner risk scores form the basis for?
questions.question_ar: على شنو تقوم درجات الخطر الصادرة من الماسحات؟
options: Vulnerability prioritisation matrices.
Penetration test scoping documents.
Service level agreements with vendors.
Employee security awareness scores.
options_en: Vulnerability prioritisation matrices.
Penetration test scoping documents.
Service level agreements with vendors.
Employee security awareness scores.
questions.explanation: Formalised risk scores are what let an enterprise build a prioritisation matrix instead of working through findings in scan order.
questions.explanation_ar: درجات الخطر المصاغة هي اللي تخلي المؤسسة تبني مصفوفة ترتيب بدل ما تشتغل على النتائج بترتيب الفحص.

questions.question: Why does the chapter insist tools must be integrated rather than listed?
questions.question_ar: ليش الفصل يشدّد إن الأدوات لازم تتكامل مو بس تُعدّ؟
options: Because integrated suites are always cheaper to buy.
Because regulators forbid standalone security tools.
Because each tool must use the same vendor.
Because isolated tools leave gaps that adversaries exploit.
options_ar: لأن الحزم المتكاملة أرخص بالشراء دائماً.
لأن كل أداة لازم تكون من نفس المورّد.
لأن الأدوات المعزولة تترك فراغات يستغلها الخصوم.
options_en: Because integrated suites are always cheaper to buy.
Because regulators forbid standalone security tools.
Because each tool must use the same vendor.
Because isolated tools leave gaps that adversaries exploit.
questions.explanation: A WAF that cannot inform the SIEM, or a scanner whose output never reaches prioritisation, leaves the same gap an attacker walks through.
questions.explanation_ar: جدار ما يبلّغ الـSIEM، أو فاحص نتائجه ما توصل للترتيب، يترك نفس الفراغ اللي يمشي بيه المهاجم.
